sloka: न च अतिप्रणयः कार्यः कर्तव्यो अप्रणयः च ते ।उभयम् हि महादोषम् तस्मात् अंतर दृक् भव ॥४-२२-२३॥
transliteration: na ca atipraṇayaḥ kāryaḥ kartavyo apraṇayaḥ ca te ।ubhayam hi mahādoṣam tasmāt aṁtara dṛk bhava ॥4-22-23॥

translations.english: 'You are not to be excessively friendly or otherise as both are serious mistakes. Therefore, be insightful.'
